title: What is known about 1RB0RA_1LC0RA_0LD0LC_1RD1RE_1LF0LE_---0LB
description: Proof status of the six-state BB(6) holdout 1RB0RA_1LC0RA_0LD0LC_1RD1RE_1LF0LE_---0LB.
intro: Nobody knows whether this six-state, two-symbol Turing machine halts when started on a blank tape: it is one of the holdouts left open by the bbchallenge project. This page lists what has been established about it, sorted by what each result rests on.
verdict: The question is open. It is close to, but not the same as, the question for 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF. Mirrored and with its states renamed this machine is that one, started in that machine's state F; after its first step it runs that machine from a tape with one extra 1, and in the first 109 steps the two tapes stay equal except for that 1 at the end of the wall (C). Lean proves (kernel) that a halt needs an E-run (halt_needs_erun), the mirror of the other machine's D-run.

claims.title: The halting configurations
claims.text: The machine stops exactly when it reads the symbol of a halting transition (F0); the generated statement covers every configuration.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10,000 steps
claims.text: The list simulator of the shared library, proved to agree with the machine's semantics, runs 10,000 steps from blank tape without a halt, evaluated by Lean's kernel.

claims.title: No halt in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps
claims.text: The same run, evaluated by compiled code.

claims.title: A halt needs an E-run
claims.text: Two steps before a halt the head is in state E reading a 1: F (halting on a 0) is entered only from E0, and E from D1 (then F reads the 1 that D wrote) or from E1.

claims.title: The run of 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF from a tape with one extra 1
claims.text: Mirror this machine and rename A..F to F, A, B, C, D, E: the table is the other machine's, started in its state F, whose first step writes a 1 and enters its state A. Run from that tape side by side with the other machine from blank tape, at all 32,539 left-end records of the first 10<sup>9</sup> steps the tapes agree except for one extra 1 at the end of the far wall, and the step counts differ by 56 (57 with the first step), constant since step 4,194,242.

claims.title: The analysis
claims.text: Everything in the analysis of 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF applies in the mirror: a sea of 1010 with particles pushed by a 2-bit gadget like a counter with carries; the machines could only differ on a trip that reaches the wall.

claims.title: Does it halt from blank tape?
claims.text: Open, as for the other machine.

claims.title: Related holdouts
claims.text: The same table as 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF up to renaming and mirroring, started in another state; no common configuration in the first 10<sup>7</sup> steps of each.

explainer.lede: Nobody knows yet. The question is close to another holdout's, but separate: this machine is 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF seen in a mirror and started one step later, and it runs the same tape with one extra 1 at the far end. Lean proves it can only halt during an E-run, which so far has only happened at the far wall.

facts.text: A halt needs E erasing 1s (Lean, kernel).
Same tape as the other machine plus one 1, for 10<sup>9</sup> steps.
No halt in the C simulator.

sections.heading: The shape of the run
html: Left of the start, the visited part of the tape stopped growing in the second half of the run (bounded so far, or growing so slowly that no record fell in the last half). Right of the start it grows like the square root of the step count, the signature of a head sweeping back and forth across the whole tape and adding a cell or a few at the end of each sweep (a bouncer-like shape) (fitted exponent 0.516).
After 109 steps the tape spans 65,135 cells (56 left of the start, 49,806 right), with a density of 1s of 0.525.
These are measurements of one bounded run, sorted by tools/py/bbtools/triage.py; the macro structure behind them is the next thing to find.

sections.heading: The same table as another holdout
html: Write the table, swap L and R, and rename the states A, B, C, D, E, F to F, A, B, C, D, E. The result is exactly the table of 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF. The only difference is where it starts: this machine starts in what is there state F. Its first step writes a 1 and moves into state A of the other machine, so from then on it is the other machine started on a tape with one extra 1.

The extra 1 drifts to the far wall of 1s and stays there. Running both side by side for 109 steps, the tapes are equal except for that one 1 at every moment the head makes a new record, and this machine is always 57 steps behind (56 since step 4,194,242, plus its first step). The two runs could only part ways on one of the rare trips of the head that reach the wall.

So the story of this machine, the sea of 1010, the particles, the little counter at one end and the carries, is told on the page of 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF. Lean proves here the mirror of its halting condition: two steps before a halt, E must be erasing a 1 (halt_needs_erun).

sections.heading: Related machines
html: Other holdouts of the list of 608 that are tied to this one. The comparison of tables is exact; everything about runs was checked on the first 107 steps of each machine and is an observation, not a proof (holdouts/related.py, holdouts/related.json).

Same table as the machine below, started in another state. Renaming the states as shown turns this machine's table into the other one, the halting transition included. The other machine starts in its own state A, which is not this machine's A: its run from blank tape is the run of this table started in another state. These are different runs: in the first 107 steps of each, no configuration of this machine's run occurs in the other, even up to a shift of the tape. So each of these holdouts is its own halting question, and settling one does not settle another.

  • 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF: rename A→F, B→A, C→B, D→C, E→D, F→E and exchange left and right; it is this table started in state B, in a mirror

family: particles in a 1010 sea, counter-like (fixed/sqrt); twin of 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF
summary: The mirror image of 1RB0LF_0RC0RB_1LC1LD_1RE0RD_---0RA_1LA0LF, started one step later: its run is that machine's run with one extra 1 at the far wall; a halt needs an E-run, which has only happened at the wall.
